subject: Request: Launch Kickstart Bundle — combined credits & rate exception

Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@orbitio.ai>; procurement@orbitio.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch support request — credits + rate carve

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood. We have a hard go-live target for an internal pilot the week of July 12 and would like to accelerate onboarding. To get the pilot to production-grade reliability we need two things to close internally: a 6-week trial extension (we were quoted 4 weeks in the POC) and a launch "kickstart" bundle that combines $50k in free inference credits plus a temporary reduced token rate for the first 3 months.

I attached our Q2 Pilot Projection (small file) so you can see expected consumption. Procurement would like a single approval email from Redwood leadership to move forward. Can you confirm whether this is doable and what the approval path looks like?

Appreciate it —
Elena Park
Director of AI Platforms, Orbitio Labs
Elena Park | Orbitio Labs

Subject: Re: Launch support request — credits + rate carve

Elena —

Thanks for the projection, got it. Short answer: we can support a combined credit + temporary rate concession, but this requires an exec-level carve-out due to the size ($50k credits + tiered rate). I want to put together the minimal paperwork and a clear success metric (activation + token usage threshold) so leadership can sign off.

Proposed approach (for internal approval):
- 6-week trial extension (no change to data retention)
- $50,000 free inference credits applied over first 90 days
- 15% discounted token rate for first 3 months after activation (then revert to standard)
- Success metric: 3m active API calls/month and ML evaluation pass-rate >= 92% on sample prompts

I'll escalate to Marissa and Karhtik for exec approval. If acceptable I can draft the short approval note and the SOW redline.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Why I recommend approval:
- Strategic fit: strong healthcare data connectors, potential to expand across 3 product teams this year
- Low downside: credits are time-limited and we attach measurable activation gates
- Accelerates renewal/commit conversation in Q4 (deal ID D-2027-0743)

Ask: executive approval for the combined sweetener (credits + rate carve) and permission to sign a short SOW addendum. Proposed guardrails in the draft: total credit cap $50k, discounted rate expires after 90 days or if usage < 30% of projected, and automatic reversion to standard rate.

Aditya —

Thanks for the context. I ran the numbers with finance and product; two quick follow-ups before I can grant an exception:
1) Please attach a 12-week consumption forecast (daily granularity) and highlight burn-rate assumptions.
2) Confirm compliance sign-off (SOC2/data residency) is not required for this pilot or outline any additional checks.
3) Proposed rollback trigger: if latency or error-rate regress beyond our SLOs for two consecutive weeks, the concession is revoked.

If procurement needs a signed email, I can provide it once the items above are satisfied. I’m okay in principle with the $50k cap + 15% temporary rate discount provided we have the guardrails. For the SOW addendum, legal prefers a short term (90d) with a single docsig link.

Draft approval note I can sign (subject to answers above):
"Redwood Inference approves a one-time launch sweetener for Orbitio Labs: $50,000 inference credits applied over the first 90 days and a 15% temporary token rate discount for the first 3 months, subject to activation metrics and operational guardrails as outlined. Approval valid only after acceptance of the attached project projection and compliance confirmation."

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick responses and the SOW. Based on the projection and the security attestation provided, Redwood Inference approves a one-time Launch Kickstart Bundle for Orbitio Labs under the following conditions:
- $50,000 inference credits applied across the first 90 days from activation (non-transferable)
